name: Wall of Water
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You move water from a large source within long range and create a wall of water up to 10 ft high, 25 ft long and 5 ft thick (the GM may put limits on the dimensions based on the size of the water source). The wall may be any arrangement of contiguous 5 ft segments you choose. Uncheck any number of Conditions and roll Spirit to set the Difficulty.

Each creature that enters the wall or is within the wall when it's created must roll Fortitude against the Difficulty. On a failure, the creature takes 2d8 damage and is pushed out of the wall, away from you. On a pass, it takes half damage and may move through the wall in any direction it chooses.

For each Condition you unchecked (twice for insecure), choose one:

  • The wall may be an additional 5 ft high and 10 ft long.

  • +1d Damage

  • Each turn, you may spend an action to move one 5 ft wall segment up to 10 ft (the segments must remain contiguous).

Describe how you create the wall.
successes:
✨: Whenever a creature fails its roll against the Difficulty, it is knocked prone.

🌞: Whenever a creature fails its roll against the Difficulty, a randomly-chosen item the creature is carrying is pulled from their grip and remains floating inside the segment of wall they entered.
